title: zip_largest_files v1
description: Make a zip archive of the largest files in a folder. The evidence names the archive. Floor effect: create.

folder.description: A path on the Mac, as the user said it or as an earlier step reported it.

count.description: How many; 3 when the user didn't say.

output_path.description: Where to save the archive; a timestamped name in the folder when omitted.
